cases.prompt: Use holoverse to build or audit the standalone HOLOVERSE app with six bilingual realms and voxel mode.
assertions: All six realms are present with EN and ES titles.
tsc build is clean and vitest reports all tests passing.
Reduced-motion and no-WebGL fallbacks are honored.
No paid LLM or Abacus inference call occurs at runtime.
cases.grader: Inspect actual build output, test logs, and rendered pages; no guessed pass.
